summary: RMG ML Sports Holdings filed an 8-K reporting the consummation of its IPO of 20,000,000 units at $10.00/unit ($200M gross), a simultaneous private placement of 210,000 units to sponsor for $2.1M, and the underwriter's partial exercise of the over-allotment option for 1,650,000 additional units. Proceeds were deposited into a trust account. This is a standard SPAC IPO disclosure, not an actionable special situation event. No investor action required; watch for future business combination announcements.
